questions.evidence: mock_v2 36 and 56 px rows: green and red lenses with halos and the unlit dark lens still read apart on all four looks. The smaller lens is still clear at 36 px.
The dark lens is still smoked glass with a bezel and glint and no halo. It reads as an unlit bulb, not a colour or a missing texture.

v2_ref_vs_lamp_112: in every look and every state the lamp sits on the lower-left of the body. The Industrial open handle (up-left) is fully visible, as are the Scrapper open diagonal lever and closed bar, the Modern red toggle, and the Futuristic central lever and cyan bar. Each lever matches its reference art.
Round lens with a soft round halo. No square edges, clipping or new artefacts at 36, 56 or 112 px.

Industrial closed cells: the baked green LED is now a small dark round dot in the same place. It reads as an unlit pilot LED on the panel, not as an artefact, and it no longer glows beside a dark lamp.

polish: At 36 px the dark lens almost disappears on the dark Scrapper, Industrial and Futuristic bodies. That fits 'no glow', but a player cannot see that a lamp exists there. Taste only.
Futuristic closed art keeps its own cyan glow in the closed-unpowered state, beside the dark lamp. This is base art, carried from v1.
Modern open state still has the red toggle beside the red lamp. Still readable, carried from v1.
